source_text: Prefer many fast unit tests over a few slow e2e tests; the testing pyramid is a cost-and-feedback-speed argument, not dogma.
pattern: Prefer many fast unit tests over a few slow e2e tests; the testing pyramid is a cost-and-feedback-speed argument, not dogma.
reason: Fast feedback is what makes tests run at all.

source_text: One test asserts one behavior; when a test breaks, the failure should name the behavior, not force a forensic read.
pattern: One test asserts one behavior; when a test breaks, the failure should name the behavior, not force a forensic read.
reason: Failure messages are the tests' documentation.

source_text: Tests must be deterministic — no wall-clock time, no network, no shared mutable state; a flaky test destroys trust in the whole suite.
pattern: Tests must be deterministic — no wall-clock time, no network, no shared mutable state; a flaky test destroys trust in the whole suite.
reason: Trust is the entire point of a test suite.

source_text: Every bug fix ships with a regression test that fails before the fix and passes after; without it the bug is only suppressed, not fixed.
pattern: Every bug fix ships with a regression test that fails before the fix and passes after; without it the bug is only suppressed, not fixed.
reason: The reproducer is the proof of the fix.

source_text: Coverage measures risk exposure, not correctness; aim for high coverage on core logic and boundaries, not vanity line coverage everywhere.
pattern: Coverage measures risk exposure, not correctness; aim for high coverage on core logic and boundaries, not vanity line coverage everywhere.
reason: Coverage is a map of where you are not looking.
